import sys, math
from collections import defaultdict
p=sys.argv[1]; out=sys.argv[2]
pts=defaultdict(list)
with open(p) as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('ATOM') and line[12:16].strip()=='CA':
            ch=line[21]
            pts[ch].append((float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])))
allpts=[v for vs in pts.values() for v in vs]

def pca(vs):
    n=len(vs); mx=sum(x for x,y,z in vs)/n; my=sum(y for x,y,z in vs)/n; mz=sum(z for x,y,z in vs)/n
    xx=yy=zz=xy=xz=yz=0.0
    for x,y,z in vs:
        dx=x-mx; dy=y-my; dz=z-mz
        xx+=dx*dx; yy+=dy*dy; zz+=dz*dz; xy+=dx*dy; xz+=dx*dz; yz+=dy*dz
    xx/=n; yy/=n; zz/=n; xy/=n; xz/=n; yz/=n
    A=[[xx,xy,xz],[xy,yy,yz],[xz,yz,zz]]
    # jacobi eigenvalue
    V=[[1.,0.,0.],[0.,1.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]]
    for it in range(100):
        p_=0;q_=1
        off=abs(A[p_][q_])
        for i in range(3):
            for j in range(i+1,3):
                if abs(A[i][j])>off:
                    off=abs(A[i][j]); p_=i;q_=j
        if off<1e-12: break
        apq=A[p_][q_]
        if abs(A[p_][p_]-A[q_][q_])<1e-15: theta=math.pi/4
        else: theta=0.5*math.atan2(2*apq, A[p_][p_]-A[q_][q_])
        c=math.cos(theta); s=math.sin(theta)
        for i in range(3):
            if i"'!=p_ and i!=q_:
                aip=A[i][p_]; aiq=A[i][q_]
                A[i][p_]=aip*c+aiq*s; A[p_][i]=A[i][p_]
                A[i][q_]=-aip*s+aiq*c; A[q_][i]=A[i][q_]
        app=A[p_][p_]; aqq=A[q_][q_]
        A[p_][p_]=app*c*c+2*apq*s*c+aqq*s*s
        A[q_][q_]=app*s*s-2*apq*s*c+aqq*c*c
        A[p_][q_]=A[q_][p_]=0.0
        for i in range(3):
            vip=V[i][p_]; viq=V[i][q_]
            V[i][p_]=vip*c+viq*s
            V[i][q_]=-vip*s+viq*c
    vals=[A[i][i] for i in range(3)]
    order=sorted(range(3), key=lambda i:-vals[i])
    return (mx,my,mz), vals, [[V[i][j] for i in range(3)] for j in order]

lines=[]
try:
    import numpy
    lines.append('"'numpy\\t'+numpy.__version__)
except Exception as e:
    lines.append('numpy\\tmissing\\t'+repr(e))
lines.append('group\\tn\\tcentroid_x\\tcentroid_y\\tcentroid_z\\teig1\\teig2\\teig3\\taxis1_x\\taxis1_y\\taxis1_z\\taxis2_x\\taxis2_y\\taxis2_z\\taxis3_x\\taxis3_y\\taxis3_z')
def emit(name,vs):
    (cx,cy,cz),vals,vecs=pca(vs)
    lines.append(f'{name}\\t{len(vs)}\\t{cx:.3f}\\t{cy:.3f}\\t{cz:.3f}\\t{vals[0]:.3f}\\t{vals[1]:.3f}\\t{vals[2]:.3f}\\t'+'\\t'.join(f'{v:.6f}' for vec in vecs for v in vec))
emit('all',allpts)
for ch in sorted(pts): emit(ch,pts[ch])
with open(out,'w') as g: g.write('\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n')
print('\\n'.join(lines))

import sys, math, zlib, struct
import numpy as np
p=sys.argv[1]; outca=sys.argv[2]; outall=sys.argv[3]

def read(atoms_only_ca):
    pts=[]; chains=[]
    with open(p) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith('ATOM'):
                an=line[12:16].strip()
                if atoms_only_ca and an"'!='"'CA':
                    continue
                pts.append((float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])))
                chains.append(line[21])
    return np.array(pts), np.array(chains)

def pca_axes(pts):
    q=pts-pts.mean(0)
    cov=q.T@q/len(q)
    w,v=np.linalg.eigh(cov)
    order=np.argsort(w)[::-1]
    return v[:,order]

def write_png(fn, arr):
    h,w,c=arr.shape
    raw=b''.join(b'\\x00'+arr[y].tobytes() for y in range(h))
    def chunk(tag,data):
        return struct.pack('>I',len(data))+tag+data+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(tag+data)&0xffffffff)
    sig=b'\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n'
    ihdr=struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0)
    with open(fn,'wb') as g:
        g.write(sig); g.write(chunk(b'IHDR',ihdr)); g.write(chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,6))); g.write(chunk(b'IEND',b''))

def render_montage(pts, chains, big_mask):
    pc=pca_axes(pts)
    views=[('Projection along Z (XY)',np.array([1.,0.,0.]),np.array([0.,1.,0.])),
           ('Projection along Y (XZ)',np.array([1.,0.,0.]),np.array([0.,0.,1.])),
           ('Projection along X (YZ)',np.array([0.,1.,0.]),np.array([0.,0.,1.])),
           ('PCA 1 vs PCA 2 (along PC3)',pc[:,0],pc[:,1]),
           ('PCA 1 vs PCA 3 (along PC2)',pc[:,0],pc[:,2]),
           ('PCA 2 vs PCA 3 (along PC1)',pc[:,1],pc[:,2])]
    cols=3; rows=2
    W=1000; H=700; margin=50
    arr=np.full((rows*H, cols*W,3), 255, dtype=np.uint8)
    for idx,(title,a,b) in enumerate(views):
        r=idx//cols; c=idx%cols
        x0=c*W; y0=r*H
        u=pts@a; v=pts@b
        umin=u.min(); umax=u.max(); vmin=v.min(); vmax=v.max()
        # equal aspect with padding
        spanu=umax-umin or 1; spanv=vmax-vmin or 1
        scale=min((W-2*margin)/spanu,(H-2*margin-40)/spanv)
        ox=(W - spanu*scale)/2; oy=(H - spanv*scale)/2 + 0
        # draw title using simple 5x7 font (only uppercase/digits/spaces)
        def text(img, tx, ty, s, color):
            for ch in s:
                if ch==' ':
                    tx+=6; continue
                idxfont=ord(ch)
                if idxfont<65 or idxfont>90:
                    tx+=6; continue
                pattern=FONT[idxfont-65]
                for j in range(7):
                    bits=pattern[j]
                    for i in range(5):
                        if bits & (1<<(4-i)):
                            yy=ty+j; xx=tx+i
                            if 0<=yy<img.shape[0] and 0<=xx<img.shape[1]:
                                img[yy,xx]=color
                tx+=6
        text(arr, x0+10, y0+8, title, (0,0,0))
        # plot as disks radius 3 for CA, radius 1 for all atoms
        radius=3 if len(pts)<5000 else 1
        for i,(uu,vv) in enumerate(zip(u,v)):
            xi=ox+ (uu-umin)*scale
            yi=oy+ (vmax-vv)*scale
            color=(220,30,30) if big_mask[i] else (30,70,220)
            x=int(round(xi)); y=int(round(yi))
            for dy in range(-radius,radius+1):
                for dx in range(-radius,radius+1):
                    if dx*dx+dy*dy<=radius*radius:
                        yy=y0+y+dy; xx=x0+x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<rows*H and 0<=xx<cols*W:
                            arr[yy,xx]=color
    return arr

# tiny 5x7 font for uppercase A-Z
FONT={
0:[0x0E,0x11,0x11,0x1F,0x11,0x11,0x11],1:[0x1E,0x11,0x11,0x1E,0x11,0x11,0x1E],2:[0x0E,0x11,0x10,0x10,0x10,0x11,0x0E],3:[0x1E,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x1E],4:[0x1F,0x10,0x10,0x1E,0x10,0x10,0x1F],5:[0x1F,0x10,0x10,0x1E,0x10,0x10,0x10],6:[0x0E,0x11,0x10,0x13,0x11,0x11,0x0E],7:[0x11,0x11,0x11,0x1F,0x11,0x11,0x11],8:[0x1F,0x04,0x04,0x04,0x04,0x04,0x1F],9:[0x01,0x01,0x01,0x01,0x01,0x11,0x0E],10:[0x11,0x12,0x14,0x18,0x14,0x12,0x11],11:[0x10,0x10,0x10,0x10,0x10,0x10,0x1F],12:[0x11,0x1B,0x15,0x15,0x11,0x11,0x11],13:[0x11,0x19,0x15,0x13,0x11,0x11,0x11],14:[0x0E,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x0E],15:[0x1E,0x11,0x11,0x1E,0x10,0x10,0x10],16:[0x0E,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x15,0x12,0x0D],17:[0x1E,0x11,0x11,0x1E,0x14,0x12,0x11],18:[0x0F,0x10,0x10,0x0E,0x01,0x01,0x1E],19:[0x1F,0x04,0x04,0x04,0x04,0x04,0x04],20:[0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x0E],21:[0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x11,0x0A,0x04],22:[0x11,0x11,0x11,0x15,0x15,0x1B,0x11],23:[0x11,0x11,0x0A,0x04,0x0A,0x11,0x11],24:[0x11,0x11,0x0A,0x04,0x04,0x04,0x04],25:[0x1F,0x01,0x02,0x04,0x08,0x10,0x1F]}

pts_ca, chains_ca=read(True)
big_ca=np.isin(chains_ca,['A','D'])
arr_ca=render_montage(pts_ca, chains_ca, big_ca)
write_png(outca, arr_ca)
pts_all, chains_all=read(False)

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
for name in ['ca','all']:
    im=np.array(Image.open(f'/workspace/galaxy_{name}.png').convert('RGB'))
    H,W,_=im.shape
    rows=2; cols=3
    ph=H//rows; pw=W//cols
    print('IMAGE',name, im.shape)
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            panel=im[r*ph:(r+1)*ph, c*pw:(c+1)*pw]
            # downsample to 80x36; mark red #, blue ., other spaces
            out=[]; gh, gw=panel.shape[:2]
            for y in range(0,gh,max(1,gh//36)):
                line=''
                for x in range(0,gw,max(1,gw//80)):
                    pix=panel[y,x]
                    R,G,B=int(pix[0]),int(pix[1]),int(pix[2])
                    if R>180 and G<100 and B<100: line+='#'
                    elif B>150 and R<120: line+='.'
                    elif R<50 and G<50 and B<50: line+='+'
                    else: line+=' '
                out.append(line)
            print('panel',r,c)
            print('\\n'.join(out))
            print()
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /workspace/compare_pdb.py <<'PY'
import sys, numpy as np
p1=sys.argv[1]; p2=sys.argv[2]; out=sys.argv[3]

def read_ca(path):
    d={}
    order=[]
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith('ATOM') and line[12:16].strip()=='CA':
                key=(line[21], int(line[22:26]), line[17:20].strip())
                if key not in d:
                    d[key]=[float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])]
                    order.append(key)
    return d,order
r1,o1=read_ca(p1); r2,o2=read_ca(p2)
common=[k for k in o1 if k in r2]
missing=[k for k in o1 if k not in r2]
extra=[k for k in o2 if k not in r1]
a=np.array([r1[k] for k in common]); b=np.array([r2[k] for k in common])
delta=a-b
dists=np.linalg.norm(delta,axis=1)
rmsd=float(np.sqrt((dists**2).mean()))
maxd=float(dists.max()); med=float(np.median(dists))
with open(out,'w') as g:
    g.write('metric\\tvalue\\n')
    g.write(f'n_query_ca\\t{len(o1)}\\n')
    g.write(f'n_reference_ca\\t{len(o2)}\\n')
    g.write(f'n_common\\t{len(common)}\\n')
    g.write(f'n_missing_in_reference\\t{len(missing)}\\n')
    g.write(f'n_extra_in_reference\\t{len(extra)}\\n')
    g.write(f'ca_rmsd_angstrom\\t{rmsd:.6g}\\n')
    g.write(f'max_abs_coordinate_delta\\t{maxd:.6g}\\n')
    g.write(f'median_abs_coordinate_delta\\t{med:.6g}\\n')
    g.write(f'identical_ca_0_001\\t{int((dists<0.001).sum())}\\n')
    g.write(f'identical_ca_0_01\\t{int((dists<0.01).sum())}\\n')
print('rmsd',rmsd,'common',len(common),'missing',len(missing),'extra',len(extra))
PY
wc -l /workspace/compare_pdb.py"
